insights.content: DTC #1 is 3-1 in 35B after a closer-than-expected 3-2 win over DTC #3. Kiyono/Jarvis were deployed at D3 and lost — a costly lineup call given Kiyono (3.33→3.56) belongs at D1. Corelle (3.41 baseline, 2-1 at S1) beat Tayoni Coleman. Allen/Waters at D1 and Paull (3.31→3.48) + Perdomo (3.31→3.51) both won, but DTC #3 (35B) took S2 and D3. DTC #1 is tied with Dragonridge at 3-1, both trailing Red Rock CC #2 (4-0) who leads 35B.

Dragonridge CC swept Spanish Trail #1 5-0 and is tied with DTC #1 at 3-1. TPC beat Desert Palm 3-2 and is 3-2. Red Rock CC #2 leads 35B at 4-0. W6 — DTC #1 vs Dragonridge — decides who is best-placed behind Red Rock.

Summerlin swept Anthem CC 5-0 in 35A. They are now 4-1, tied with DTC #2 (4-1). Nicole Reyes (DTC #2, 3.69→3.77, 4-0 at S1) is the division's highest-rated active player. Sarah Perez (Summerlin, 3.48→3.69, 3-0) is a major Summerlin riser. Rika Cook (3.46→3.51, 4-1) and Nancy Holland (3.41→3.50, 3-1) anchor Summerlin. Yan Uyeno (Red Rock #1, 3.35→3.44, 4-1) is actually RISING from her true 3.35 baseline — not declining as she appeared with incorrect ratings. 35A is essentially a Summerlin-DTC#2 race.

Kelly Nguyen (DTC #3, 3.27 baseline, 0-4 in 35) is the clearest decliner. Lisa Gobel (Spanish Trail #2, 3.48→3.34, 0-2) and Jan Willis (LTF, 3.43→3.06, 0-3) are both sliding hard. Joann Komanowski (LTF, 3.48→3.32, 0-2) is another LTF decliner. Carolyn Wood (TPC, 3.30→3.00, 0-3) has collapsed entirely.

Biggest 35B risers: Melanie Isbell (Dragonridge, 3.04→3.57, 4-0 at S1/S2) is the division's standout riser — +0.53 from baseline. Arika Carrier (TPC, 3.16→3.57, 4-0 at D1) has risen +0.41 from her real baseline. Jamie Johnson (TPC, 2.95→3.48, 3-0) is another massive riser (+0.53) — a genuine surprise weapon. Mary Lind (Red Rock #2, 3.37→3.60, 4-0) is rising steadily. 35A: Seda Sargsyan (DTC #2, 3.61→3.67) leads singles; Nicole Reyes (3.69→3.77) leads the division overall.

sections.title: 04/25 — next match preview: DTC #1 vs DRAGONRIDGE CC

insights.content: DTC #1 (3-1) vs Dragonridge (3-1) — this is the 35B title match. Winner controls the top spot behind Red Rock. Dragonridge just swept Spanish Trail #1 5-0 and is playing their best tennis.

Melanie Isbell (3.04→3.57, 4-0) is Dragonridge's singles engine — her +0.53 rise is the biggest in the division. Corelle (3.41 baseline, 2-1) is DTC #1's S1 option at a lower current rating. Isbell is favored but not a certainty — she's been climbing fast and DTC #1 needs Corelle to compete here.

DTC #1's Amy Waters (3.66→3.70) and EMELIA ALLEN (3.68→3.69) are a legitimately strong D1 pair with high baselines and should be favored against Dragonridge's D1. Don't misplace Kiyono (3.33→3.56) at D3 again — that lineup call cost a line against DTC #3 (35B).
3-2 either way. Dragonridge is the slight favorite on current form (5-0 last match, Isbell dominant). DTC #1 needs Waters/Allen to hold D1 and Corelle to compete at S1.
vs DRAGONRIDGE CC (3-1). Melanie Isbell (3.04→3.57) at S1/S2 is the key threat. 35B title implications. Must-win.
vs SPANISH TRAIL #1 (1-4). Fading fast — lost 0-5 to Dragonridge in W5. DTC #1 should win 4-1.
vs RED ROCK CC #2 (4-0+). Toughest match remaining. Mary Lind (3.37→3.60) and a deep roster with Tanya Hale (3.47→3.60) and Shanna Toft (3.54→3.58). Probable loss without the full lineup.
vs TPC (3-2). Arika Carrier (3.16→3.57) is their D1 force and a genuine threat. Jamie Johnson (2.95→3.48) is another surprise weapon. DTC #1 should win 3-2 if D1 is matched correctly.
Win W6 (Dragonridge) to control 35B. Even a loss there doesn't eliminate DTC #1 — they have the easier remaining schedule. Win W7 and W9, steal one from Red Rock #2, and DTC #1 finishes in the top 2.
